test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_topk_ts (metric_name, tags, time_series) SELECT 'load', map('instance', toString(number), 'dc', toString(number % 10)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(100 + step * 10, 3), (sipHash64(number, step) % 1000000) / 1000), range(300)) FROM numbers_mt(4000)
